experiment: HGB combinations with log-target random forest and ExtraTrees

rf_log.selection: Frozen published RF log-target F1 specification; no new parameter search

extra_trees.selection: Mean three-inner-fold MAE; candidate order resolves exact ties

hgb: Frozen published leaves63__time_risk. Reuse verified nested HGB OOF only within its matching outer training partition; reuse published HGB outer predictions only on the matching outer validation fold.
combinations: 50/50 mean of HGB and the family prediction
Nonnegative MAE-optimal weights summing to one, with zero intercept, fitted only on inner OOF
comparators: Previous tuned Ridge/RF/HGB constrained MAE stack
evaluation: Keep the existing outer fold assignment. Generate inner OOF using KFold(3, shuffle=True, random_state=33) on the sorted outer training rows. Fit every preprocessing step within its fitting partition. Select ExtraTrees raw versus log target using only inner-fold MAE. Freeze combination weights before scoring outer validation. Report mean outer-fold MAE, RMSE and paired fold changes.
holdout_policy: Do not load, predict or score the existing test set. Do not fit a final deployment model.
target_transform: For log-target candidates, fit log1p(y) and return expm1 predictions; floor predictions at zero in original days.
feature_policy: F1 is the published calendar/interaction feature pack. F1_time additionally uses fold-fitted elapsed purchase days and year-month encoding. RF and ExtraTrees do not use the learned risk feature.
limitations: The HGB and RF configurations, dataset and evaluation folds have informed earlier development; this is further retrospective development, not a new independent confirmation.
The ExtraTrees search only compares two target representations with fixed tree settings and one feature pack; it does not establish the best attainable ExtraTrees performance.
Different input representations and objectives may contribute to differences between model families.
Random folds describe the same historical order mixture, not future periods or unseen sellers.
